articles.summary: Cua Driver connects an exact Chromium tab to its native process and window, giving agents page-aware browser actions and full desktop control in the same session—without a Chrome extension.
articles.title: Blending the best of computer and browser use, without a Chrome extension

articles.summary: A process-scoped Metal capability shim unlocks newer GPU paths inside a Lume macOS VM, making llama.cpp prompt processing up to 11× faster and token generation up to 16× faster on an M1 Ultra.
articles.title: Apple Silicon and macOS VMs: 11–16× Faster LLM Inference with llama.cpp
